title: Public Deliberation Plan: National Anti Counterfeiting Product Integrity and Quality Standards Bill
proposal: National Anti Counterfeiting Product Integrity and Quality Standards Bill

publication.plain_language_summary: Mandatory digital track-and-trace QR codes on goods, severe penalties up to life imprisonment for fake medicines/food, asset forfeiture of counterfeiting syndicates, 10x consumer compensation.
publication.full_draft: Draft text published on Consumer Affairs & Law Ministry portal.
publication.impact_notes: Consumer protection and trade impact notes.

deliberation.stakeholder_roundtables: Roundtables with consumer forums, retail associations, BIS

remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Substantive structural changes to track-and-trace rules
